contract.global_kv: Full encoder-boundary mHC attention input, before decoder row packing; global caches use original full metadata.
contract.decoder: Per-request long chunks retain their trailing128 decoder rows. Short chunks continue same-request private decoder SWA. Packed positions, residual/mHC mixes and token IDs stay aligned.
contract.prefix_reuse: Decoder/draft SWA is not published to prefix caching. Global/encoder hits leave at least128 prompt tokens; encoder sparse retention pins that same reachable boundary. No giant encoder-hidden cache added.
contract.outputs: Full original-row hidden/aux ABI; discarded rows zero. Prompt-logprobs requests including zero keep full decoder rows. DSpark combines/projects only packed valid context rows, with original query anchors/rejection masks.
contract.approximation: Chunk-wise bounded SWA replay intentionally differs from full-decoder prefill; no exact greedy-token parity with the unoptimized reference is claimed.

serving.profiler_during_acceptance_timings: Configured but inactive; no profiler trace during timing.

performance.ratio_direction: before latency / after latency; greater than1 is faster
performance.interpretation: 4K/16K TTFT improved1.92x/2.02x beyond the preceding structural optimization. Decode samples overlap; no established decode speedup claim.
